neighbours.label: the slot right before 'soluble' (water-|s|oluble, water soluble, -ins|oluble)
fire: Thiamine is a water-soluble vitamin found in grains.
The drug forms a crystalline, water-insoluble salt.
Since folate is a water-soluble vitamin, it is not stored.
Poorly water soluble drugs are hard to absorb.
The extract is nearly 40% water soluble in tests.
The dye is a bright, water-soluble powder.
Chitin is a tough, water-insoluble polymer.
The new form is ten times more water-soluble than before.
quiet: Thiamine is a common vitamin found in grains.
The drug forms a crystalline, heat-resistant salt.
Since folate is a useful vitamin, it is often added.
Poorly stored drugs are hard to sell.
The extract is nearly 40% water by weight in tests.
The dye is a bright, water-proof powder.
Chitin is a tough, water-cooled polymer.
The new form is ten times more stable than before.

notes: Direct logits promote ' diss', ' dissolved', ' melt' on the + pole. At the sentence start 'Water-soluble' reached only 0.26 and 'Insoluble' 0.17 in the probes, so items keep it mid-sentence. 'Fat-soluble' reached 0.32.
